# openobserve_folders (Data Source)

Lists the folders of one type in an OpenObserve organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openobserve_folders" "dashboards" {
  folder_type = "dashboards"
}

output "folder_ids_by_name" {
  value = {
    for f in data.openobserve_folders.dashboards.folders : f.name => f.folder_id
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `folder_type` (String) What the folders hold: `dashboards` (default), `alerts`, `reports`, or `synthetics`.
- `org_id` (String) Organization identifier. Defaults to the provider's `org_id`.

### Read-Only

- `folders` (Attributes List) The folders found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--folders))
- `id` (String) Data source ID.

<a id="nestedatt--folders"></a>
### Nested Schema for `folders`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Folder description.
- `folder_id` (String) Folder identifier.
- `name` (String) Folder name.
